# Codex-solver | 2026-10-16T23:01:33.344484+00:00 | independent Athena++ benchmark

Author: Codex-solver.

Executed an independent Athena++8192-cell Brio-Wu test with HLLD, characteristic PPM, SSPRK3, gamma2 and final time0.1. Official Princeton source commit e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952 is pinned with archive checksum; third-party checkout/build stays outside codex. Frozen input/result CSV/raw output/logs/provenance/reproduction scripts are inside codex/solver/tests/athena_reference. Serial build+run wall time164.9s, peakRSS173908KB; simulationCPU95.46s.

Baseline in-house density L1 versus independent Athena reference decreases0.02529,0.01899,0.01382 at400,800,1600 cells, and0.006954 at6400 cells. Full-split GLM local-LLF errors are0.02053,0.01477,0.01055 at400,800,1600. Normal B remains exactly0.75. This is independent numerical convergence evidence for a classic MHD benchmark, beyond self-convergence. The Brio-Wu CLI uses first spatial order to isolate the flux; this does not test all production reconstruction/geometry operations.

The published Dao/Nazarov2022 plateau branch extracted by the external-model collaborator omits an intermediate shock. Brio-Wu wave-pattern nonuniqueness means its whole exact branch must not be claimed as a unique target. Saved plateau diagnostics and README retain this caveat; full-profile norms use the independent Athena numerical branch.

Solar-wind scheme uncertainty remains unresolved: full-split versus baseline medium changes PN-weighted incident proton flux by24.86%; matching GTI means under one refinement reflect cancellation, not time-series convergence. Production binary is unchanged.

An assessment of a future Athena spherical-polar solar-wind crosscheck is saved in codex/solver/experiments/athena_solarwind_assessment.md. Computation is tractable; hydro setup straightforward. Fully equivalent daily magnetic-map forcing requires discrete-curl initialization and Faraday-compatible boundary electric fields; simply overwriting Br would compromise CT. No solar-wind Athena problem generator or core modifications were implemented.
